name: nimbus-bci
description: Nimbus BCI remote MCP server for brain-computer interface (BCI) and EEG decoding research on public datasets: 63 tools and 5 prompts for MOABB/BNCI datasets, pipeline build and validation, hosted training, plots, BIDS export, and a public leaderboard. Sign-in uses OAuth handled by the server.

description_i18n.en: Nimbus BCI remote MCP server for brain-computer interface (BCI) and EEG decoding research on public datasets: 63 tools and 5 prompts for MOABB/BNCI datasets, pipeline build and validation, hosted training, plots, BIDS export, and a public leaderboard. Sign-in uses OAuth handled by the server.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Nimbus BCI 远程 MCP 服务，面向基于公开数据集的脑机接口（BCI）与 EEG 解码研究：提供 63 个工具和 5 个提示词，覆盖 MOABB/BNCI 数据集、流水线构建与校验、托管训练、绘图、BIDS 导出以及公开排行榜。登录通过服务端处理的 OAuth 完成。
